# PolyPid Announces Positive Top-line Results from Phase 2 Clinical Trial of D-PLEX100 for the Prevention of Surgical Site Infections in Abdominal Surgery


October 2019


D-PLEX 100 Administration into the Surgical Site Led to Statistically Significant Reduction in Infections Compared to Standard of Care Alone Company Intends to Hold End of Phase 2 Meeting with FDA and Subsequently Submit an IND to Conduct a Phase 3 Clinical Trial in Abdominal Surgery Petah
